description: Range elements are filtering syntax used after the 'range' keyword in 3DEC commands. They select subsets of blocks, zones, gridpoints, faces, contacts and subcontacts by geometric region, attribute, or logical condition.

attribute.name: Attribute Elements
attribute.description: Select objects by ID, group, or other attributes

logical.description: Select by selection/visibility state or another named range

elements.name: orientation
elements.short_description: Select objects with a matching orientation, or direction in space. The orientation may be specified by dip and dip-direction, or by a normal vector.

elements.name: surface
elements.short_description: Select zone faces if they fall on the “surface” of the model, which is defined as a face with only one zone connected to it, or a face with only one valid non-null zone connected to it.

elements.name: geometry-distance
elements.short_description: Select objects that fall within a certain distance of points, edges, and polygons defined in the geometry set named s. This geometric element accepts the extra keyword.

elements.name: geometry-space
elements.short_description: Select objects by their location in relation to the polygons in the geometry set named s. A direction vector is specified, and a ray is emitted from the location of the object in that direction.

elements.name: component-id
elements.short_description: For most objects, this is the same as the id range element. It selects objects based on an ID number assigned to an object internally upon creation.

elements.name: component-id-list
elements.short_description: For most objects, this is the same as the id-list range element. It selects objects based on an ID number assigned to an object internally upon creation.

elements.name: displacement
elements.short_description: Select an object with displacement between the specified upper and lower limits. Use the by keyword to limit by sub-objects (e.g., block-gridpoint).

elements.name: set
elements.short_description: Select based on a parent/child relationship. id i Id of set to filter by.

elements.name: state
elements.short_description: Select objects by the state indicators of the zone constitutive model. The s is matched to any state name returned by the constitutive model.

elements.name: dfn
elements.short_description: Select objects based on their distance from the discrete fracture network with name s. Additional fracture networks can be added to the same element using the name keyword.

elements.name: selected
elements.short_description: Include selected objects. This causes the range to only consider objects that are selected. [common problem] See ref-selecthide-.

elements.name: deselected
elements.short_description: Include not selected objects. This causes the range to only consider objects that are not selected. [common problem] See ref-selecthide-.

elements.name: use-hidden
elements.short_description: Include hidden objects. By default, an object that has been hidden will never by included by a range. If this keyword is specified, hidden objects will be considered. [common problem] See ref-selecthide-.

elements.name: project-range
elements.short_description: Inserts the project named range s as an element within the current range phrase. Project named ranges can be created in the user interface, and may only be used validly in plotting commands.

elements.name: aspect-ratio
elements.short_description: Select blocks with a maximum aspect ratio between fl and fu. The aspect ratio is the maximum edge length divided by the cube root of the volume.

elements.name: concave
elements.short_description: Select blocks that are concave. Other objects will be selected if they are associated with a block that matches the criterion.

elements.name: deformable
elements.short_description: Select blocks that are deformable (zoned). Other objects will be selected if they are associated with a block that matches the criterion.

elements.name: dfn-3dec
elements.short_description: Select faces, contacts or subcontacts created by t

elements.name: edge-length
elements.short_description: Select blocks whose minimum edge length is between fl and fu. Other objects will be selected if they are associated with a block that matches the criterion.

elements.name: excavated
elements.short_description: Select blocks that are excavated (block excavate).

elements.name: face-area
elements.short_description: Select blocks whose minimum face area is between fl and fu. Other objects will be selected if they are associated with a block that matches the criterion.

elements.name: group-intersection
elements.short_description: Select objects at the intersection of blocks in group s1 and blocks in group s2 (in slot s3, or any slot). Selects the contacts or faces between two block groups, e.g. a tunnel surface before excavation.

elements.name: index-list
elements.short_description: Select objects whose index (offset) is in the list; the numbers need not be sequential.

elements.name: jmodel
elements.short_description: Select subcontacts whose joint constitutive model name matches s (see block contact jmodel).

elements.name: joint-set
elements.short_description: Select objects associated with any of the given joint-set IDs.

elements.name: leader-id
elements.short_description: Select objects associated with the given block leader ID (joined blocks). Unjoined blocks have leader ID 0 and are not selected. Zones, faces and gridpoints are selected if the host block matches.

elements.name: velocity
elements.short_description: Select objects whose velocity magnitude is between fl and fu. Use 'by' to evaluate sub-objects (e.g. block-gridpoint).

elements.name: volume
elements.short_description: Select objects whose volume is between fl and fu.

elements.name: wall
elements.short_description: Select blocks that are walls. Other objects will be selected if they are associated with a block that matches the criterion.

notes: Multiple range elements create intersection (AND) by default
Unspecified range affects all objects of target type

3DEC 7.00 Release 161 (2026-08-21): all 22 documented range elements appear in the live 7.0 range-slot enumeration (probed via 'block hide' — 67 tokens, a superset with unified-kernel extras such as project-range/undo). No documented element is missing in 7.0.
Related commands: model range create, model range delete, model range list

All 22 documented elements are present; the ~37 undocumented extras include unified-kernel entries (wall, contact, ...) - acceptance of a token does not imply 3DEC data behind it. 3DEC is 3D-only: no 2D-specific elements (circle/radius) appear.
